objective: Screen three sleeve-combination weight rules (M1 equal-thirds, M2 half S1 half S3, M3 trailing-63-session inverse-volatility), each against its own preregistered volatility-matched delevered-S3 control (Ci), plus M0 (S3 alone) as a fixed reference, for whether combining the three live paper sleeves at a fixed proportion beats delevering S3 alone to the same realized volatility on Sharpe and stress-period drawdown, without breaking the frozen anchor-window return bar.

common_start: first session all three sleeves hold a non-cash position

vol_matched_delevered_control_ci.description: Ci = k*S3 + (1-k)*SHY for the paired Mi; k in (0,1] solved by bisection separately per evaluation window so std(Ci daily return) == std(Mi daily return) over that window; k capped at 1.0 if Mi's volatility >= S3's. Rebalanced daily at the fixed per-window k, no cost (conservative in the control's favor).

per_candidate: (a) Mi passes G1 or G1' at 10bp in the anchor window
(b) Mi still passes G1 or G1' at 20bp in the anchor window
(c) Sharpe(Mi) - Sharpe(Ci) >= 0.10 in both the anchor window and the stress period
(d) Mi's stress-period max drawdown is shallower than Ci's stress-period max drawdown
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: three Mi (M1-M3); report all regardless of outcome
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: no combined-account live pilot on this evidence; keep S3 alone
